title: ChatGPT → Midjourney Content Workflow
result_first_title: Complete workflow from text concept to AI-generated visuals
short_description: Step-by-step workflow to generate blog/Instagram content using ChatGPT for copy and Midjourney for images.
emotional_hook: 이 워크플로우는 아이디어 하나로부터 글과 이미지가 함께 자라나는 창작의 흐름을 만든다.

steps.action: Generate blog post outline and key visual concepts
steps.prompt_template: Write a blog post about [topic]. Include 3 key sections. For each section, describe what kind of image would support the content.

steps.instruction: Search PromptFlow for prompts matching the visual concepts from step 1
Copy prompts from PromptFlow and generate in Midjourney. Use --ar 16:9 for blog headers, --ar 1:1 for Instagram.
Layout the blog post or social carousel with generated images
Use Buffer, Later, or native scheduling
